supersedes_design: jlz-shared-subject-v3; historical artifacts and live jobs unchanged
claim: Joint native local-delta targets across all eligible write layers; arm B adds history-conditioned ridge realization/preservation cost at the z stage.

scope.joint_variables: D_l columns are direct native subject deltas
scope.generic_B: actual B_t, including final partial batch; no hardcoded method batch size
scope.generic_layers: all ordered eligible sites from model profile, with per-layer d_in/d_out and native-write mapping

inputs.NLL_reduction: mean target tokens, mean six contexts, sum requests

native_core.KL_teacher: entry native KL subject-last full-vocabulary distribution
native_core.anchor: fixed entry canonical subject-last block output
native_core.single_active_layer_eta0: native objective form at that layer; not original independent stopping trajectory

allocation.assumption: A positive definite; no silent jitter or layer deletion
allocation.cost_dtype: Q, I-Q, V and analytic gradient in FP64; cast final policy gradient to delta FP32 for accumulation
allocation.history_monotonicity: fixed K,D and PSD H increment only
allocation.Q_near_zero_limit: V tends to quadratic delta norm and may lose directional discrimination

arms.name: B
arms.meaning: native core plus normalized history-conditioned ridge value

eta_status: explicit uncalibrated initial setting; no claimed optimum

realization.per_layer: layer-major full-token propagation; gather all actual B current pooled keys before one write; same A_batch_entry; U=D_star P_current.T
realization.materialized_action: (W_new.double()-W_entry.double()) @ K_current.double(); distinguish from cast32(U)K and from actual linear-output rounding
realization.history: append saved native FP32 prewrite pooled keys once after all writes succeed, only when parameter-dependency proof guarantees equality to post-all-write keys; otherwise recapture final keys
realization.rollback: all five layers and H on technical failure
realization.history_arithmetic: preserve native FP32 pooled key, Gram and H addition order; never substitute solve FP64 K

compute.cache: entry through exact earliest intervention operation; for current profile L4 pre-injection output and strict pos<subject L5-L31 K/V; suffix graph recomputed
compute.capability_fallback: same native objective and writer reference route; no loss/context/layer/budget reduction
compute.batched_selected_head: full vocabulary, preserve each readout/norm and hidden-to-delta autograd
compute.padding: crop original token arrays; stable buckets with explicit row/target/absolute-position mapping and common A/B reduction policy
compute.KL_future_prune: only causally unused post-readout positions; original full input tokens/spec retained
compute.entry_fusion: teacher/anchor/key/cache detached captures during differentiable zero candidate; if loss/gradient returned consumes first of25, otherwise preparation costs extra
compute.factorization: FP64 same-layer same-arm same-batch-entry A Cholesky reused for entry/current K; refactor after native H append
compute.dual_backend: T=cholsolve(A,K); S=I+K.T*T; P=T*solve(S,I); E=solve(S,I), using right solve for P
compute.policy_cost: G=D E/s^2 once; normalized V=0.5*inner(D,G); Q=sym(K.T P) for diagnostics
compute.large_B_backend: exact primal factor and blocked RHS / implicit E action, retaining all B coupling; no dense Q required
compute.factor_storage: RAM only; host/GPU buffers included in resource caps; no persistent resume-equivalent storage
compute.solve_count_semantics: legacy 5entry/5current are key-system solve requests, not required independent large factorizations; exact L4 reuse can skip one current solve
compute.writer: all-request keys before each materialized weight update, then full-token propagation; fit prefix cache is not reused across actual weight writes
compute.history_key_forward: eliminated only with proof prewrite input key invariant to own/later parameter writes
compute.sync: device accumulation and candidate-boundary finite/clamp checks; no per-microbatch CPU .item requirement
compute.generic_policy_dense_GFLOP_formula: 2*sum_l d_out_l*B_t^2 /1e9, only when dense E backend is used

math_validation: math/; CPU toy only, source SHA bound
numeric_fields_scope: Current Llama3/CounterFact execution profile only; generic B/layers/dimensions/native inputs/readout/metrics are adapter-provided.
